items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The rhythm section was “Monkey,” Robert Parker, on piano... So that’s the whole personnel.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was the lead player. Kimbal Dial, whom we called “Cabbage,” was the tenor player, and Willie Parker, “Weasel,” was the other tenor player. The rhythm section was “Monkey,” Robert Parker, on piano, Singleton Palmer – “[?Caudry],” we called him – on bass. The drummer was “[?Sign],” Earl Martin. Jimmy Cowans was our vocalist, part-time, and Jimmy Britten was the other vocalist. We never had a girl. So that’s the whole personnel.
How would you rank the band with the bands that you played with?
